现场还设置了出片打卡点，前五十位到店客人满赠礼遇限定明信片。早鸟福利预售现已开放，感兴趣的话可以了解一下。活动时间：周六至周日 11:00–18:00。

en:standard.primary_copy:
Make the weekend a coffee one. Our Pop-up Store is coming to Anfu Road, Shanghai, in partnership with a local ceramics studio, bringing together yuzu cold brew and handmade coffee cups.

There will be a Check-in Spot on site, and the first fifty guests through the door who reach the purchase threshold will receive a limited-edition postcard. Early-bird reservations are open now if you'd like to find out more. Event hours: Saturday to Sunday, 11:00–18:00.
